summary: Signal B is a low-significance (about 3 sigma), post hoc candidate. File times confirm the order of events. The pool multisector check produced its result at 02:54:49Z and wrote its SUMMARY at 03:07:17Z; its free-epoch fit had locked 61.7 h away from the S98 epoch. The anchored S6+S32 recovery scan (signal_11d.py) was first written at 03:26:34Z. The about-3-sigma figure refers only to that archival link test: FAP 2e-3 (19/10,000) = 2.88 sigma one-sided. That value is conservative, because its null is inflated by an edge artefact at the end of S32. A trials factor of 2 for the failed search, or a wider window, lowers it to 2.5-2.7 sigma; cleaner nulls raise it to 3.7-4.3 sigma. S98 alone does not establish B. Its S98-only FAP runs from 2e-4 to about 1, depending on photometry, flux column and statistic, and even 2e-4 means about 25 false alarms over the 126,246-star search. The final ephemeris is P = 11.13274 +- 0.00003 d and T0 = 2461000.865 +- 0.003 BJD_TDB; it is valid only if the archival dips are real. All six candidate fits lie within 0.4 sigma of it. The common depth is about 1000 ppm. Per-sector depths depend on reduction choices, and S98 is deeper than the archival mean by about 2 sigma (0.6-3.3 sigma). Rp is about 2.2 R_E on target and about 2.0 with the density free. For S110 I predict three transits: 2026-11-01 11:24, 11-12 14:35 and 11-23 17:45 UTC, each +-5 min. The earlier times of 11:29-11:31 omit the 5.6-7.0 min barycentric light-time. The revision's B text is accurate and says 'post hoc'. I propose two MINOR additions: that S98 alone does not establish B, with the FAP; and the S110 gaps clause, which REQUIRED_CHANGES C9 lists but the revision omits.

manuscript_findings.quote: has two clean Sector 98 transits and dips in Sectors 6 and 32 consistent with its period, at $\approx3\sigma$ in a recovery test that I defined after an unanchored archival search had failed.
manuscript_findings.problem: Accurate and correctly says post hoc, but it does not say that Sector 98 alone does not establish the signal (S98-only FAP 2e-4 to ~1; about 25 or more false alarms expected over the 126,246-star search), and it gives no FAP for the recovery test, so a reader cannot tell what '3 sigma' refers to.
manuscript_findings.fix: has two clean Sector 98 transits, which alone do not establish it. Dips in Sectors 6 and 32 match its period at $\approx3\sigma$ (false-alarm probability $\approx2\times10^{-3}$) in a recovery test that I defined after an unanchored archival search had failed.

manuscript_findings.quote: TESS Sector 110 (2026 October 31 to November 26) spans eight or nine 3.18\,d and three 11.13\,d transit times.
manuscript_findings.problem: The count and dates are correct (B epochs 31-33: 2026-11-01 11:24, 11-12 14:35, 11-23 17:45 UTC, +-5 min). But REQUIRED_CHANGES C9 and referee R19 list the clause 'some possibly in gaps or scattered light' as implemented, and it is missing. S110 gap days are still TBD at HEASARC.
manuscript_findings.fix: TESS Sector 110 (2026 October 31 to November 26) spans eight or nine 3.18\,d and three 11.13\,d transit times, some possibly in gaps or scattered light.

manuscript_findings.quote: assuming the archival dips are real, its ephemeris is $P=11.13274\pm0.00003$\,d and $T_0=2461000.865\pm0.003$ BJD$_{\rm TDB}$.
manuscript_findings.problem: None: matches the final values (all implementations within 0.4 sigma), and it is correctly conditioned on the archival dips.

manuscript_findings.quote: The weaker 11.13\,d signal ($\approx$2.2\,$R_\oplus$ if on the target; $\approx3\sigma$ in a post hoc test) is reported with its ephemeris.
manuscript_findings.problem: None: the radius (2.23-2.28 R_E, density prior) and the significance wording match the final facts.

found in Sector 98 and traced back to Sectors 6 and 32
manuscript_findings.problem: For B, 'traced back' is the post hoc about-3-sigma link, and its S32 support is weak (S32-alone FAP 0.02-0.05). The same abstract qualifies this ('about 3 sigma in a post hoc test'), so it does not overstate.
manuscript_findings.fix: no change (optional: 'found in Sector 98 and matched in Sectors 6 and 32')

manuscript_findings.quote: A weaker 11.13\,d signal ($\approx$1000\,ppm; $R_p\approx2.2\,R_\oplus$ if on the target;
manuscript_findings.problem: None: the common model depth is 996-1005 +- 70 ppm. The offset in the same parenthesis is T3's topic.
